document.retrieval_note: The maintainer downloaded it in a browser on 2026-10-27. The host's robots.txt (https://www.uhc.com/robots.txt, read 2026-10-27) disallows /ifp/, which covers this address, for automated fetching, which this check did not do.
document.read_with: pdftotext -layout and pdftotext -raw, both with -enc UTF-8. The SBC is printed pages 1 to 6 of 6, which are PDF pages 1 to 6; PDF pages 7 to 12 are the carrier's nondiscrimination and language notices. The -layout output interleaves the columns of the service chart on pages 2 and 3, so its rows were read from the -raw output. The chart's columns are "Network Provider (You will pay the least)" and "Out-of-Network Provider (You will pay the most)"; page 1 says "All copayment and coinsurance costs shown in this chart are after your deductible has been met, if a deductible applies.", and a copay printed with "deductible does not apply" is checked as applies_to_deductible false, every other value as true. The prescription drug rows (page 2) are not checked, as in the UHC Bronze Essential check: the medical MVP's services are medical.
